summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; no tests were run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, 4 cells per indent level) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint to the measured maximum (capped by explicit width), and a new VerticalCenter class with repr, newline-based vertical padding, and measurement; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased, keeps the existing entry, and adds an Added subheading with two entries; tests/test_tree.py adds test_measure_tree (expects Measurement(11, 19)); tests/test_align.py adds repr, render, and measure tests for VerticalCenter. Expected test values were derived by reading the code, not by running it, so a test run is still needed to confirm them.
